description: 🚀 Astra Core is a team of six enthusiastic Computer Science Engineering and Data Science Engineering students participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Shivamogga. Our project, SpacePulse, aims to build an astronaut health-monitoring dashboard using simulated health data, visual charts, and alerts for unusual readings. We are passionate about space exploration, coding, innovation, teamwork, and developing technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges.
summary:
Orbit Health – Monitoring Astronaut Health Beyond Earth

Orbit Health is a software-based astronaut health-monitoring platform developed by Team ASTRA CORE for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It aims to provide a centralized and user-friendly interface for viewing and understanding astronaut health information during space missions. The platform presents health-related readings through a dashboard, helping users observe trends and identify unusual changes that may require further attention.

Orbit Health addresses the challenge of making astronaut health information more accessible, organized, and easier to interpret in the demanding environment of space missions. By bringing relevant health indicators together in one platform, it supports clearer health-data visualization and monitoring.

This project is important because astronaut well-being is essential for mission safety and success. Orbit Health demonstrates how accessible digital technology can support health-data monitoring and contribute to the development of smarter tools for future space exploration.
details:
Project Details – Orbit Health

Orbit Health is a software-based astronaut health-monitoring platform developed by Team ASTRA CORE for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It is designed to make astronaut health information easier to access, understand and monitor during space missions.

What does it do and how does it work?

Orbit Health provides a centralized digital interface for presenting astronaut health information. Its dashboard is intended to organize relevant health indicators and help users observe changes and trends over time. By presenting information in a clear and accessible format, the platform aims to make health monitoring more convenient and understandable.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Astronauts experience unique environmental and physiological challenges during space missions. Monitoring their health is important for their well-being and mission success. Orbit Health aims to support better understanding of health information, improve visibility of health trends and help identify unusual readings that may require further attention. In the future, it could be expanded to support additional health parameters and more advanced data analysis.

Technology and Tools Used

The application was developed using FlutterFlow, a visual application development platform. The project focuses on creating an accessible interface and presenting health-related information in an organized manner.

Creativity and Innovation

The main innovation of Orbit Health is its focus on bringing astronaut health-monitoring information into one accessible digital platform. Rather than making users interpret scattered readings, it aims to provide a more organized and user-friendly monitoring experience.

Our team considered usability, clarity of information, relevance to astronaut health and the challenges of monitoring human well-being during space exploration while developing this solution.

Orbit Health represents our effort to apply software technology to an important challenge in future human space missions.
